metadata.description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It contains the current German R823 LaTeX source control; cumulative English, Spanish, French, and Interslavic working readers; bounded components in additional languages; and editable source, provenance, repair, render, and audit material.

Current bounded additions: source-audited English Paper 4 Sections 4 and 5; complete bounded Japanese Paper 23; Korean Paper 29 U01 and U02; exact editable/evidence packages; and dedicated project-render packages. Paper 4 now has separate bounded public units for the Introduction/Postscript and Sections 1-5, continuing at Section 6 / R823 line 4045. The Korean units cover source lines 1-39, with line 40 blank and item 2 at line 41 next. They do not complete Paper 29.

Japanese Paper 23: the four-page target PDF and editable TeX are exact producer bytes. Structural, formula, footnote, terminology, adverse-evidence, evidence-graph, build, extraction, and visual controls are included. All four project-generated page renders are open payloads with stable IDs VE-NOE-P23-JA-001 through 004. No source-scan pixels are redistributed.

Korean Paper 29: U01 covers the introduction at source lines 1-24; U02 covers Section 1 at lines 25-39. Each has one editable TeX and one one-page PDF. U01 publishes two project PNGs and represents two source visuals by metadata only. U02 publishes five project PNGs and represents three source JPEGs by metadata only. The source images remain privately preserved because redistribution rights were not established. Public evidence excludes private operational material, raw path-bearing logs, and rejected reconstruction binaries while retaining exact producer-hash receipts.

Visual evidence: files 30-32 provide eleven project-generated page/reconstruction renders in total: four Japanese Paper 23, two Korean U01, and five Korean U02. Rights-blocked source-image sets are not silently omitted: their hashes, geometry, page coordinates, and dispositions remain in the public-safe metadata.

Status caveat: these are substantial machine-assisted working editions, translations, source controls, and review artifacts. Bounded source-audit claims apply only to their stated units. They are not official critical editions, peer review, proof certification, independent human scholarly review, native-language/community certification, accessibility certification, rights determinations, complete Paper 4 or Paper 29, or guarantees that every symbol and translation choice is correct. OCR/VLM output is locator or comparison evidence unless direct source reconciliation is explicitly recorded.

GitHub: corrections and improvements can be proposed through issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.

additional_descriptions.description: Reader-first multilingual Noether working corpus: German R823 source control; cumulative English, Spanish, French, and Interslavic readers; bounded components in additional languages; editable source, repair, provenance, render, and audit evidence. This version adds bounded English Paper 4 Sections 4-5, complete bounded Japanese Paper 23, and Korean Paper 29 U01-U02 with rights-aware visual evidence. Paper 4 continues at Section 6 / R823 line 4045; Korean Paper 29 continues at line 41 / item 2. Not complete Paper 4 or Paper 29, a critical edition, native-language certificate, peer review, proof check, rights determination, or whole-corpus guarantee.

access_status.description_l10n: The record and files are publicly accessible.
